pagerbot: [ALERT] HIGH - kv_cache growth & perf cliff on inference-runtime-r3 (rope scaling / long-context). Error rate +12%, 95th latency x4. Triggered 2026-03-10 03:02:03 UTC. Paging oncall group @oncall. Incident link: https://redwood.ops/incidents/INC-2026-045

Sasha: ack — oncall here, starting triage. tagging infra and runtime leads.

Jess: I'm grabbing runtime logs and recent config changes. Noting that the recent NTK/YaRN rope-scaling flag was enabled in prod at 02:45 UTC for rollout.

Neal: ETA on root node logs? Are we seeing KV cache size blowups or just batching stalls?

Jess: initial grep shows KV cache entries ballooning. sample from runtime-r3: 
```
2026-03-10T03:05:12Z runtime-r3 kv_cache.size=1.2e6 entries usage=98% evictions=0
2026-03-10T03:06:01Z runtime-r3 kv_cache.size=2.4e6 entries usage=196% OOM-guard triggered
```
Seems eviction wasn't kicking in after the rope-scaling changed the addressing for sliding window.

Ana: that matches a hypothesis: rope indexing changed token key shapes (NTK/YaRN sliding window) so KV key normalization didn't match, preventing hits and leaving stale prefixes in cache, causing unbounded growth.

Rory: I'm checking rollout config. The feature flag `enable_rope_scale_v2` was turned on in canary then promoted to prod at 02:45. Canary metrics looked fine because canary traffic had short contexts. Prod saw many long-context streaming sessions ( > 64k tokens ) which hit the new code path.

Mike: customers with long conversations should be affected. CS flagged higher latency for `acme-co` around 03:04 UTC.

Sasha: severity = P1 (potential customer-visible outages). Mitigation options: 1) revert rope-scale flag 2) force eviction policy to aggressive LRU 3) reduce continuous batching window / lower batch size 4) route long-context traffic to older model variant. We should pick a quick safe hotfix.

Jess: I'm pushing for immediate revert of `enable_rope_scale_v2` for prod and putting a temporary rate-limit on long-context endpoints. Revert is rollback-safe.

Rory: I can flip the flag. Command I will run: 
```
# feature-flag revert
redwoodctl feature set enable_rope_scale_v2 --env=prod --value=false --actor=rory
```

Rory: running now. Applying to all inference clusters.

deploy-bot: rollout started by Rory for feature enable_rope_scale_v2 -> false on cluster prod at 2026-03-10T03:12:40Z.

Rory: rollout succeeded across prod at 03:14 UTC. Verifying metrics.

Jess: while revert is propagating, I'm applying an emergency kv eviction override to avoid immediate second-order blowups: 
```
redwoodctl config set inference.kv_cache.eviction_policy LRU --env=prod
redwoodctl config set inference.kv_cache.max_entries 500000 --env=prod
```

deploy-bot: config change applied by Jess at 2026-03-10T03:16:05Z.

Sasha: I'm lowering continuous batch window on the live route: `continuous_batch_window_ms` from 120 -> 40 for the streaming endpoint to reduce pileups.

Neal: evidence of improvement: 03:18 logs show KV size dropping and eviction rate increasing: 
```
2026-03-10T03:18:20Z runtime-r3 kv_cache.size=480k entries evictions=420k hit_rate=0.12
2026-03-10T03:19:05Z runtime-r3 p95_latency reduced from 2.4s -> 0.9s
```

Mike: Customer impact: partial timeouts and stream disconnects for `acme-co`, `fintech-pro`, `edu-ai` between 03:02-03:16 UTC. CS notified and we opened incident cases.

Sasha: live mitigation summary: (a) reverted rope-scaling feature flag, (b) increased eviction max_entries + set LRU, (c) lowered batch window, (d) routing rule applied to divert known long-context customers to stable model variant.

Neal: handoff: I'm taking oncall for next hour 03:30-04:30 UTC to watch for regressions while metrics stabilize. Jess will own postmortem/next steps.

Jess: postmortem owner = Jess. Immediate action items for postmortem: - root-cause confirm how rope key normalization bypassed eviction; - add unit/integration tests for KV keyshape changes; - create safe rollout guard when enabling rope-scale (thresholds on KV growth by context-length); - add automatic rollback if kv_cache size > X or eviction rate=0 for > 2m.

Rory: also proposing a rollout change: feature flags that change key encodings must require a migration run (rekeying or eviction) on each instance before enabling.

Sasha: customers notified, CS is sending status updates. Tagging @oncall for visibility.

Mike: logging note: capture rope key fingerprints in a sampled manner to see new key shapes. Will add small patch to tracing for next deploy.

Sasha: ok we'll keep monitoring for next 2 hours. I'll update the incident with a summary and link to the postmortem doc once Jess creates it. Great work team. :thumbsup:
